blurb: Guests can take guided tours including the Trails and Ale Tour, Alaska Native Tour, Tram and Juneau Tour Combo, or a self-guided Map and App Tour. Tours feature hiking, cultural education, wildlife observation, and local history with Alaska Native perspectives. The Goldbelt Tram ascends Mount Roberts offering panoramic views and access to trails and local attractions.
